proposition.claim:
Moving x outside the minimal concentration plane V is asserted to make every hyperplane through x transverse to V, giving nu_Z(H^(delta))=O(m^-2).

An oriented cylindrical slice is identified with a full affine-plane slice and asserted mutually absolutely continuous to it; the full-plane slice mass is then identified with an oriented angular density.

Generic box slice dimension is bounded by min(dim_B E-k,0).

The induction uses a f(x/a) on [0,1]; the later dimension profile omits 1/ell.

The projected probability measure is declared robust with mass threshold delta^(-eta), followed by a nonvacuous adaptedness assertion.

Each dyadic cube is said to meet O_d(a^d) joint-partition atoms, and this is used for the reverse conditional entropy.
